chunks: A number of our companions, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Khalid, from Uthman ibn Isa, from Sama'ah, who said:
I heard Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) saying: 'Whichever believer walks regarding a need of his brother, but does not advise him, so he has betrayed Allah and His Messenger.'
ai.seo_question: What is the consequence for a believer who fails to advise their brother sincerely?
ai.summary: In al-Kafi, Shaykh al-Kulayni records this narration from Imam al-Sadiq (AS) to highlight that mere physical assistance is insufficient without sincere spiritual counsel (nasihah). The Imam equates the failure to provide genuine advice with betraying Allah and the Messenger, underscoring the depth of the bond between the believer and the Divine. This reflects the Shia emphasis on mutual spiritual accountability and the holistic nature of brotherhood in faith.
